The company has a large revenue base ($11B) but suffers from poor profitability, posting negative operating (-$459M) and net (-$640M) income margins. Structurally, the balance sheet is highly leveraged with extremely thin equity cushion (shareholders' equity of $415M against $11.8B in total liabilities) resulting in a leverage ratio near 96%, though it maintains adequate short-term liquidity with a current ratio of 1.78. These characteristics of high leverage, substantial net losses, and weak solvency margins represent high credit risk, consistent with a highly speculative grade rating.

DECISION: B-
